motion_source_license: Generated by motionlab (this repository) from the press_vertical family template and this spec.

motion_provenance.what: seated on an upright bench, back on the pad; dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward; press until the arms are almost straight and the weights meet overhead
motion_provenance.source: free-exercise-db 'Dumbbell Shoulder Press' (Unlicense, used by the app library); ACE exercise library (seated shoulder press)

motion_provenance.what: shoulder girdle rhythm (shoulder blade turns ~1 deg per 2 deg of arm elevation past ~30 deg; clavicle elevation)
motion_provenance.source: Inman et al. 1944, J Bone Joint Surg 26(1); McClure et al. 2001, J Shoulder Elbow Surg 10(3)

motion_provenance.what: muscles: anterior and lateral deltoid; triceps and trapezius synergists; serratus anterior turns the shoulder blade up

start_position: Sit tall, back against the pad, feet flat
Dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward
concentric: Bring them together above the head
top_hold: Arms almost straight, do not lock hard
eccentric: Lower slowly back to shoulder height

validation_profile.comment: Thresholds for automated checks. They catch defects in the animation data (jumps, slides, penetration, asymmetry). They do not certify exercise technique; that needs a qualified human.
validation_profile.max_hand_into_bar_comment: The skin of the palm is rigid in this rig. Up to 8 mm of palm pad inside the bar stands for soft tissue pressed flat by the load; more than that, or any finger passing through the bar, is a defect.
validation_profile.max_elbow_medial_comment: Overhead press: at lockout the hands meet above the head, so the elbows sit a few cm inside the shoulder line by design (free-exercise-db: 'push the dumbbells upward until they touch'). The default 0.02 m targets elbows tucked behind the back in squats.

technical_cues: Back stays on the pad; no arching
Forearms stay vertical under the weights
common_mistakes: Arching the lower back off the pad
Flaring the elbows straight out and behind the body
muscle_roles_note: Anterior and lateral deltoid raise the arm overhead; triceps straightens the elbow; trapezius and serratus anterior turn the shoulder blade upward (ExRx).
